title: Connected guests
demoBlocked: Sign in to a real account to manage a real guest's session.
emptyNoMatch: No guests match your search or filter.
confirmDisconnectDescription: This ends their session and forces their device off this network's router (Wi-Fi registration + DHCP lease) — not just our own record of it. They'll see the login page again if they try to reconnect.
disconnectSuccess: {{name}} disconnected — session ended and device cleared from the router
disconnectPartial: {{name}}'s session ended — device-level disconnect wasn't available for this guest
disconnectController: {{name}}'s Wyfy session ended — they'll have to sign in again. This venue's Wi-Fi is run by a controller, so their device may stay connected until it reconnects.
disconnectSessionOnly: {{name}}'s session ended. Nothing looked at their device, so it may still be connected.
disconnectControllerRefused: {{name}}’s Wyfy session ended, but the controller didn’t confirm it dropped their device — it may still be connected until it reconnects.
deviceControlsSubtitle: What this venue’s controller can be asked to do about {{name}}’s device.
deviceControlsNoMac: We don’t have a device address for this session, so there is nothing to act on here.
deviceSpeedNoProfiles: No speed profiles yet. Create one under Access Rules and it will appear here.
deviceActionError: Couldn’t reach the venue’s controller. Nothing was changed.
deviceUndoAlwaysOffered: Allow device and Remove limit are always offered: this venue’s controller does not tell us which devices it is holding off or capping, so we cannot show that here. If there is nothing to undo, nothing changes and we say so.
exportNothing: Nothing to export for these filters.
exportFailed: Could not build the export. Nothing was changed.
disconnectAllDevices_one: This guest is online on {{count}} device.
disconnectAllDevices_other: This guest is online on {{count}} devices — all of them will be disconnected.
arubaSigningOutTooltip: Signed out in Wyfy. Aruba Instant On keeps this device on WiFi until about {{time}}, when the access point's session time runs out. After that they have to sign in again.
arubaConfirmCloud: Wyfy signs {{name}} out and asks Aruba Instant On to drop their device. Instant On blocks it briefly, then they can sign in again.
arubaConfirmTimeout: Wyfy signs {{name}} out now. Aruba Instant On access points can't be told to drop a device, so theirs keeps WiFi until about {{time}}, when the access point's session time runs out. After that they have to sign in again.
arubaConfirmTimeoutNoTime: Wyfy signs {{name}} out now. Aruba Instant On access points can't be told to drop a device, so theirs keeps WiFi until the session time the access point gave it at sign-in runs out. After that they have to sign in again.
arubaDisconnectNote: Aruba Instant On can't drop a device on command: the guest is signed out in Wyfy and loses WiFi when the access point's session time runs out.
arubaDisconnectNoteCloud: Wyfy signs the guest out and drops their device through Aruba Instant On.
arubaDisconnectDropped: {{name}} disconnected — Aruba Instant On confirmed it dropped their device
arubaDisconnectSignedOut: {{name}} is signed out. Their device keeps WiFi until about {{time}}, when the access point's session time runs out.
arubaDisconnectSignedOutNoTime: {{name}} is signed out. Their device keeps WiFi until the access point's session time runs out, then they have to sign in again.
